name: OpenClaw
description: 开源个人 AI 助理运行时：跑在你自己的服务器上，通过 WhatsApp/Telegram/Discord/Slack 等渠道与你交互，内置 Web 控制台。

install.detect: command -v openclaw >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes || echo no

inputs.label: 网关访问密码
inputs.placeholder: 至少 8 位，强度自行保证

steps.name: 下载并安装 OpenClaw（--no-prompt 全程免交互 + --verify 安装后自检）
steps.command:
maj=$(node -v 2>/dev/null | sed -E "s/^v([0-9]+).*/\1/")
if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ] && [ "${maj:-0}" -lt 24 ]; then
  echo "检测到默认 Node $(node -v 2>/dev/null) 不满足要求（>=24.22）：经 nvm 非交互安装 Node 26…"
  . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  nvm install 26 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  nvm use 26 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
curl -fsSL --proto "=https" --tlsv1.2 https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash -s -- --no-prompt --no-onboard --verify

steps.name: 初始化 + 安装守护进程（非交互 + 跳过风险提示）
steps.command:
[ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ] && { . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; nvm use --silent 26 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/systemd/user"
chmod go-w "$HOME/.config" "$HOME/.config/systemd" "$HOME/.config/systemd/user" 2>/dev/null || true
if ! command -v openclaw >/dev/null 2>&1; then export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/bin:$PATH"; fi
if ! command -v openclaw >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "错误：未找到 openclaw 命令（已尝试 PATH、~/.local/bin、~/bin）。请检查第 1 步安装日志。"; exit 1; fi
[ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ] && { . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; nvm use --silent 26 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/systemd/user"
chmod go-w "$HOME/.config" "$HOME/.config/systemd" "$HOME/.config/systemd/user" 2>/dev/null || true
if ! command -v openclaw >/dev/null 2>&1; then export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/bin:$PATH"; fi
if ! command -v openclaw >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "错误：未找到 openclaw 命令（已尝试 PATH、~/.local/bin、~/bin）。请检查第 1 步安装日志。"; exit 1; fi
[ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ] && { . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; nvm use --silent 26 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
if ! command -v openclaw >/dev/null 2>&1; then export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/bin:$PATH"; fi
if ! command -v openclaw >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "错误：未找到 openclaw 命令（已尝试 PATH、~/.local/bin、~/bin）。请检查第 1 步安装日志。"; exit 1; fi
openclaw onboard --non-interactive --accept-risk --gateway-auth password --gateway-password {{.gatewayPassword}} --install-daemon

steps.name: 配置网关认证与 LAN 绑定（openclaw config 热加载）
steps.command:
[ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ] && { . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; nvm use --silent 26 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/systemd/user"
chmod go-w "$HOME/.config" "$HOME/.config/systemd" "$HOME/.config/systemd/user" 2>/dev/null || true
if ! command -v openclaw >/dev/null 2>&1; then export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/bin:$PATH"; fi
if ! command -v openclaw >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "错误：未找到 openclaw 命令（已尝试 PATH、~/.local/bin、~/bin）。请检查第 1 步安装日志。"; exit 1; fi
openclaw config set gateway.auth.mode password
openclaw config set gateway.auth.password {{.gatewayPassword}}
openclaw config set gateway.bind lan
openclaw gateway install --force
D="$HOME/.config/systemd/user/openclaw-gateway.service.d"
mkdir -p "$D"
printf "[Service]\nEnvironment=OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PASSWORD=%s\n" {{.gatewayPassword}} > "$D/10-auth.conf"
chmod 600 "$D/10-auth.conf"
systemctl --user daemon-reload
openclaw gateway restart

install.notice: 将以密码模式开放网关（bind=lan，监听 0.0.0.0:18789），浏览器可直接访问 Control UI，登录密码为安装时输入的值（强度自行保证）；配置经 openclaw config 热加载。

ops.start: openclaw gateway start 2>/dev/null || openclaw gateway restart
ops.status:
pid=$(pgrep -f '[o]penclaw' | head -n1)
if [ -n "$pid" ]; then echo STATUS=running; else echo STATUS=stopped; fi
echo "PID=${pid:-0}"
up=0; mem=0
if [ -n "$pid" ]; then
  up=$(ps -o etimes= -p "$pid" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
  mem=$(ps -o rss= -p "$pid" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
fi
echo "UPTIME_SEC=${up:-0}"
echo "MEM_KB=${mem:-0}"
if ss -tln 2>/dev/null | grep -q ':18789 '; then echo LISTENING=yes; else echo LISTENING=no; fi
if curl -sS -o /dev/null -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:18789/; then echo HEALTH=ok; else echo HEALTH=fail; fi
echo "VERSION=$(openclaw --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"
ops.logs: journalctl --user -u openclaw-gateway -n {{.lines}} --no-pager 2>/dev/null || journalctl -u openclaw-gateway -n {{.lines}} --no-pager 2>/dev/null || openclaw logs 2>/dev/null | tail -n {{.lines}}
ops.openPort: p={{.port}}; if command -v firewall-cmd >/dev/null 2>&1 && firewall-cmd --state >/dev/null 2>&1; then firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=$p/tcp >/dev/null && firewall-cmd --reload >/dev/null && echo "firewalld: opened $p/tcp"; elif command -v ufw >/dev/null 2>&1; then ufw allow $p/tcp && echo "ufw: opened $p/tcp"; elif command -v iptables >/dev/null 2>&1; then iptables -C INPUT -p tcp --dport $p -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || iptables -I INPUT -p tcp --dport $p -j ACCEPT; echo "iptables: opened $p/tcp"; else echo '未找到 firewalld/ufw/iptables，请在云安全组手动放行'; fi
ops.update: openclaw update 2>/dev/null || npm install -g openclaw@latest; openclaw gateway restart

uninstall.name: 停止并移除守护进程
uninstall.command: openclaw gateway stop 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl --user disable --now openclaw-gateway.service 2>/dev/null || true; sudo systemctl disable --now openclaw-gateway.service 2>/dev/null || true

uninstall.name: 卸载程序（保留 ~/.openclaw 数据目录）
